Subject: Renewal procurement choreography: onboarding refresh + PO timing

Hi Sarah —

Thanks for the quick heads-up about the upcoming renewal. We want to align procurement steps so the capacity uplift (additional 200k tokens/month) and the 12-month term extension happen smoothly without a service gap.

Quick asks so we can stage internal approvals:
- Please confirm procurement contact and preferred PO template (if different from the one attached).
- Any specific wording your procurement team requires for data residency / retention?
- Ideal PO delivery date (we have a desired cutoff of 2026-06-24 to make the July 1 capacity bump).

I attached a short evidence checklist we typically provide to procurement (SOC2 snapshot, SLAs, billing contact). If Acme prefers ProcureSys to handle the PO intake, loop them in and we’ll coordinate.

Next steps from our side: Ben will generate the updated renewal quote and Karthik will coordinate any legal term amendments.

Thanks —
Evelyn Hart
Enterprise Renewals, Redwood Inference
Evelyn.hart@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0176

Hi Evelyn —

Thanks — confirming procurement point of contact is Jacob Myers at ProcureSys (cc’d). I attached Acme’s standard PO template and procurement guidance — we usually need a 60-day window for internal approvals but we can fast-track to your 2026-06-24 cutoff if ProcureSys ingests the request this week.

On compliance: we’ll need SOC2 Type II evidence and a short note on data retention policy for customer data (we host some tokens in US regions only). Also please confirm invoice remit information and whether Redwood can accept a single PO for the annual commitment plus a separate invoice for usage overage.

Sarah

FYI — forwarding Acme’s reply and PO template. Action items: 

- Ben: please generate the itemized quote that includes the 12-month term with the +200k token uplift and a line for committed spend vs overage billing. Highlight remit info and whether we can split PO/invoices as they requested.
- Karthik: can you confirm whether legal needs an amendment or if the existing T&Cs plus a statement of work (SOW) will suffice? If an amendment is needed, I’d like a minimal change set to avoid procurement redlines.
- Laura: post-sales will need to prepare onboarding capacity runbook and a quick 30-min kickoff after PO receipt — please draft a short readiness checklist.

I plan to reply to Sarah and loop Jacob with our plan before EOD.
